items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I'd taken two lessons from him... Mr. Jenkins introduced me to Mr. John Simon Solomon

ctx.x: But I just -- I'd taken two lessons from him, but I appreciated everything he did, 'cause everything -- I realized when Mr. Jenkins introduced me to Mr. John Simon Solomon who was the solo trumpetist at the London Symphony, and a Principal teacher at the Royal Academy, which is now the London Academy, I realized that he -- the two lessons I had with him were good.
